'''Wrack''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -2

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Any Phase''': Cast and exhaust before making a [[Combat check]].  This combat immediately ends as though you had succeeded at an [[Evade check]].  Discard this spell if the [[Ancient One]] awakens.
